summary: Current Prometeo has not silently lost the major historical cognitive layers named by the opportunity. The binding Big Picture preserves them, the vNext candidate synthesis composes many of them into explicit architecture/method contracts, and several have concrete modern descendants. However, exact literal R-era/FABRIC/Prompt-OS historical source bytes remain unevenly reopenable. This return therefore distinguishes PRESERVED/MERGED/ACTIVE_DESCENDANT from SOURCE_DEBT and never interprets search absence or omission as retirement.

method.search_rule: No-result code/history search is evidence of located-source debt only, never proof that a historical concept did not exist or is retired. Existing scouts that explicitly failed to reopen literal legacy artifacts are treated as stronger evidence of SOURCE_DEBT than ad-hoc reconstruction.

integration_recommendations.recommendation: Create or extend one historical SOURCE_DEBT registry rather than adding reconstructed prose to Master Context. Track exact R-era concept ids, located refs, missing donors, search scope and closure evidence.

Treat B_BIGPIC_01 convergence plus WI-BIG-02/06/12/14/15/17 as the current evidence-backed bridge from historical names to vNext candidates. Preserve their candidate authority labels; do not promote architecture/method merely because this ledger found convergence.

Reuse concrete descendants before inventing replacements: shared/context-foundry/v2 for context selection/receipts, Agent Network v3 for derived coordination, current authority/host-routed workflows for Airlock-like admission/apply invariants.

When legacy bytes are later recovered, compare clause-by-clause/contract-by-contract against descendants. Record ACTIVE, MERGED, SUPERSEDED or RETIRED_WITH_REASON only from explicit evidence; omission remains SOURCE_DEBT.
Keep Assembly Surface and Prompt OS as compiled/projection layers over durable sources and method heads; they must not become new product authority or mutable truth stores.

unsupported_inference_checks: Did not infer historical existence from memory alone.
Did not infer retirement from missing search hits.
Did not infer direct R70/R77/R78 lineage from modern descendants where the exact legacy donor is absent.
Did not upgrade vNext drafts from candidate to Current/Human Accepted/Served.
Did not treat working implementation descendants as proof of exact original historical semantics.
known_limitations: GitHub default-branch/code-search coverage is not an exhaustive archaeology of deleted/private transcript-era artifacts.
Some historical evidence is intentionally summarized by prior scouts because raw prior transcripts were not copied into public coordination.
This audit focused on the named R-era/FABRIC/Prompt-OS/Book/Assembly/Context/Agent-Network concepts and did not attempt full repository-wide concept taxonomy.
